objective: minimize expected annual ransomware financial loss plus annualized incremental security spending, subject to capex budget and clinical safety constraints

cost_convention.annualized_cost: capex / assumed useful life years + incremental annual opex
cost_convention.note: For first-year cash flow report full capex plus first-year opex separately. Do not add full capex and amortized capex together.

effect_rule.single_investment: At full target, new stage parameter = baseline stage parameter * (1 - target_relative_reduction); interpolate linearly from baseline to target coverage for partial deployment. Clamp probabilities to [0,1].
effect_rule.recovery_days: Apply recovery-day multipliers to incident recovery time, with a minimum plausible floor; do not modify initial access.
effect_rule.overlap: When multiple investments affect the same scenario and stage, default to strongest reduction only (conservative non-stacking); never multiply overlapping identity or segmentation effects without explicit validated combined model.
effect_rule.baseline_reference: All effects are relative to Package 2 baseline values, not absolute probability-point reductions.
effect_rule.asset_scope: I08 affects A03 conditional disruption only; do not automatically change overall major spread probability.

optimization.decision_variables: binary investment selection for initial version
constraints: I08 requires I03 or separate approved segmentation architecture
clinical-safety reporting must be shown alongside financial optimum

clinical_safety.rationale: Synthetic board-defined safety guardrails for demonstration; editable, not clinical standards.

cautions: Illustrative effectiveness assumptions, not measured causal effects.
Existing control coverage is a baseline; proposed investments must not overwrite the baseline when comparing strategies.
Use common random numbers across strategies to reduce Monte Carlo comparison noise.
No independent additive savings claims across investments.
Reputational and operational losses must avoid double-counting.
Clinical outcomes are separate metrics, not automatically converted to dollar values.
